A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same attention-sink study. All text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–I support reliable comparison. The appendix pages are identical in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original SD3 and SDXL intervention experiments, including GenEval and COCO evaluations, robustness analyses, numerical results and qualitative image comparisons.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their results in Section 3 and Appendices A–I.

M1.justification: Dynamic sink selection, score-path suppression, value replacement, and the per-head and union-budget procedures are unchanged. No algorithmic component or inference procedure is added or revised.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same text-to-image coverage: GenEval prompts, COCO captions, supplementary prompt subsets and compositional scenarios. No dataset, domain or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Unmodified generation, equal-budget random masking, fixed index-0 controls and no-op comparisons retain the same participation. Table 7 and Appendices A, G and I contain unchanged comparisons.

E3.justification: The model settings, sample sizes, intervention layers and budgets, masking protocols, metrics and practical-equivalence thresholds remain unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Both retain identical dose-response, multi-layer, phase-specific, sampling-sensitivity, modality-attribution, no-op and stronger-budget analyses. The qualitative cases in Appendix I.4 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Seed pairing, 95% bootstrap confidence intervals with 1,000 resamples, paired t-tests, one-sided tests and Holm-adjusted reporting are unchanged. No additional uncertainty estimates or run information appear.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match after accounting for relocated displays. For example, Table 2 retains CLIP-T changes of -0.0005, +0.0009 and +0.0011; Appendix I retains the same stronger-budget HPS-v2 results and image panels.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3), the intervention mathematics in Appendix A and the difference-of-differences formulation in Appendix I are identical. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims: alignment and standard-setting preference robustness, sink-specific perceptual drift, and a preference-dependent boundary under stronger interventions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of perceptual drift, FIDshift and sink necessity remain identical. Both retain the same qualifications concerning proxy metrics, aggregation versus encoding necessity, absent human studies and unrealized efficiency gains.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, numerical safeguards, sampling settings, A6000 hardware, runtime and logging information are unchanged. The code-access statement and repository address are also retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including comparisons with autoregressive sinks, diffusion-language-model findings, attention editing and sparsification. Reference movement reflects pagination only.

P1.justification: The correspondence email is updated, and paragraph formatting is tightened, including consolidation within Section 3.3.1. Scientific wording, terminology and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is reduced in size, table spacing and placement change, and Tables 1, 4, 6 and 8 gain highlighting or bold emphasis. Table 2 moves from page 6 to page 5. Display content and appendix layout remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the same scientific argument, evidence, limitations and reproducibility information, including identical appendices. The contact update and modest visual refinements change presentation without resolving a substantive deficiency or producing a meaningful overall quality difference.
